subject: Improve listpack threshold guidance in valkey.conf (#3419)
reason: The change only edits comment text in valkey.conf: it rewords the guidance around the listpack/intset threshold directives (hash-max-listpack-*, list-max-listpack-size, list-compress-depth, set-max-intset-entries, set-max-listpack-*, zset-max-listpack-*). All directive names and default values are identical before and after, and no source code or config parsing is modified, so there is no behaviour change to test.
